notes:
Leftover cards, copy, and the transfer page.

- Tools now has Check cards to format — it tells you if leftover SDs still hold a wedding's takes
- Tap the backup or Dropbox path on a transfer to open it
- Copy is more careful when the backup drive is still spinning up
- A leftover card name after a forced eject is not treated as a second card
- Stopping one wedding no longer holds up the next one's upload
